title: Gusinzira kw'ibihe vyose
intro: Ugiye gutangura urugendo rwo mu gihe, uhuye n’akabanga gakomeye k’ukwizera n’ububasha bw’Imana. Tekereza umugwi w’abantu bateye akagere amategeko yo mu kibano cabo, bafatanye n’ugusenga Imana imwe mw’isi y’ugusenga Imana nyinshi. Inkuru yabo ni igihe c’ubushobozi bwa Allah bwo kurinda abasavyi biwe b’abagororotsi mu buryo budasanzwe cane. Woba ushobora gusobanura akaranga k’abo bantu b’agatangaza?
clues: Twari umugwi mutoyi w’abasore bemera Imana imwe, naho nyene abantu b’iwacu bari bafise ugusenga Imana nyinshi.
Twarahunze umutware w’agahahazo yadutera ubwoba kubera ukwizera kwacu, kubera ko twatinya uruhamo n’urupfu.
Twararondeye ubuhungiro ahantu h’ibanga, twizigiye imbabazi za Allah n’uburinzi bwazo ku baduhahaza.
Umwami wacu yaraduteye gusinzira cane, gusinzira kw’igitangaza kwarwanya ukugenda kw’igihe.
Igihe twavyuka, twari twizera ko twaruhutse umusi umwe canke igice c’umusi gusa, tutazi igihe kinini cari caraheze vy’ukuri.
Korowani ivuga ko twagumye mu gihe cacu imyaka amajana atatu, tukarenga icenda, tukaba ikimenyetso ku bantu.
verse: And they remained in their cave for three hundred years and exceeded by nine. (Al-Kahf 18:25)
arabic: وَلَبِثُوا فِي كَهْفِهِمْ ثَلَاثَ مِائَةٍ سِنِينَ وَازْدَادُوا تِسْعًا
